note: Product floors and finish targets read by tools/product-check.mjs (owner 2026-10-11). A broken floor prints a FAIL line and lands in latest.md; a target is the finish line the board climbs toward (docs/FOCUS.md Now). Raise targets when they are met; never lower a floor to make a check green. view_* floors read the `arena view:` line: every drawn body as numbers from the CPU skin, no image (crates/game/src/view_truth.rs). look_flip_max reads the FLIP x10000 between this run's middle capture and the last green run's (LF15; crates/playtest/src/look/metric.rs is the authority, tools/iqa-gate.mjs mirrors it): the stored runs read 0-609 between green runs of different trees, 1493-1798 when the camera sat inside the props, 2185 for a black frame. input_p95_ms_max and present_p95_ms_max are the player latency bar (crates/perf/src/latency.rs p95_budget): they read the timing run only, because a capture run arms the blocking look probes and its legs price a GPU readback no player frame pays.

targets.fps_p50: 60 at 1080p on the RTX 3050 (FC3 asks 30 first)
targets.live_passes: sky, IBL, sun shadow, GTAO, bloom, TAA, particles, decals (each changes pixels when on, EG8; rows LF1-LF7, EG11)
targets.look_score: machine look score vs references (LJ1, EG30) at or above the bar Q1 sets
targets.pops: 0 joint pops per 300 frames (view line `pops`; LF9 took the attack and idle clip switches to 0; 20-37 remain in a 4-fighter duel, all in the run act, from the run clip speed scale jumping the clip phase)
targets.sunk_cm: under 2 cm (every body rests on the sand since 01572b00: dead bodies sit both ways at 0 cm, and a living body's dip is lifted out of the sand and never pushed down, so a run's flight phase stays up; the product check read 0 cm on run 82402dd2)
